scope: All 54 numbered result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 474 grid for the 11 December 2006 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the date, states a total of 54 lots across three catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 rows reconcile to the secondary grid. The secondary grid exposes lots 1-54 exactly once and reports Offered: 54. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null.
completion_scope: all numbered lots 1-54 appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 54 and the secondary Offered: 54 denominator
